semantic_review.what_changed: 'Does not need to be transferred' (permission to omit) becomes 'is not transferred', which under the candidate's indicative-as-law convention bars transfer. Also 'may share valid mechanical evidence ... under the declared independence conditions' is absent here.
semantic_review.counterexample: A frame returns a closed result sufficient for the consuming decision and also attaches its working transcript for audit. rc.2 permits the attachment; the successor's 'is not transferred' rules it out.
semantic_review.smallest_repair: Write 'need not be transferred'; restate or point to where independent evaluations may share valid mechanical evidence under declared independence conditions.

semantic_review.assessed_by: I4-04 batch 03, Fable max, same-family nonauthor, fresh context
semantic_review.scope: owning text comparison on the batch texts; consumer bindings not read
semantic_review.what_changed: Successor adds default reopening of every result bound to the prior revision, exit only by recorded re-check or re-evaluation, and calls it a tightening the predecessor implies via RF-005 and RF-011, which were not supplied.
semantic_review.counterexample: A revision names R1 and R2 for reevaluation and is silent on R3; a consumer finds R3 demonstrably independent and reuses it without a recorded re-check. rc.2 text as given permits this; the successor reopens R3 until a recorded re-check. Whether rc.2 RF-005 already forbade it decides the row.
semantic_review.smallest_repair: Supply RF-005 and RF-011; if they do not already bind every prior-revision result, record the reopen-by-default rule as a replacement relation.
